name: KromiumClientConfig
declaration: data class KromiumClientConfig(val userAgent: String? = null, val emulateDesktopEnvironment: Boolean = false, val doNotTrack: Boolean = true, val isIsolated: Boolean = false, val proxy: KromiumProxy? = null, val onBeforeDownloadListener: KromiumBeforeDownloadListener? = null, val downloadListener: KromiumDownloadListener? = null, val requestInterceptor: KromiumRequestInterceptor? = null, val navigationInterceptor: KromiumNavigationInterceptor? = null, val consoleMessageListener: KromiumConsoleMessageListener? = null, val jsDialogListener: KromiumJsDialogListener? = null, val popupListener: KromiumPopupListener? = null, val authListener: KromiumAuthListener? = null, val contextMenuListener: KromiumContextMenuListener? = null, val permissionListener: KromiumPermissionListener? = null, val loadErrorListener: KromiumLoadErrorListener? = null, val isOffScreenRendered: Boolean = true, val isTransparent: Boolean = false, val framework: KromiumUiFramework? = null, val sslErrorPolicy: SslErrorPolicy = SslErrorPolicy.Strict, val initialWidth: Int = 1280, val initialHeight: Int = 800)
description: Configuration for a specific browser client session. Determines proxy settings, user agents, transparency, OSR canvas bindings, SSL error policies, initial dimensions, and event listeners for network, downloads, and UI interactions.
whenToUse: Pass into engine.createClient(config) or client.createBrowser(url, config) to configure individual browsing sessions.

properties.name: userAgent
properties.description: Custom HTTP User-Agent string, or null to use Chromium default.

properties.name: emulateDesktopEnvironment
properties.description: Whether to emulate a standard desktop display environment.

properties.name: doNotTrack
properties.description: Whether to send DNT: 1 and Sec-GPC: 1 privacy headers.

properties.name: isIsolated
properties.description: Whether this client operates in an isolated incognito storage partition.

properties.name: proxy
properties.description: Session-specific proxy configuration overriding the global engine proxy.

properties.name: onBeforeDownloadListener
properties.description: Callback to resolve target paths or cancel file downloads before transfer begins.

properties.name: downloadListener
properties.description: Callback to monitor file download progress and completion events.

properties.name: requestInterceptor
properties.description: Interceptor for inspecting, modifying, or blocking outgoing HTTP/HTTPS web resource requests.

properties.name: navigationInterceptor
properties.description: Interceptor for evaluating and overriding top-level frame navigations.

properties.name: consoleMessageListener
properties.description: Listener for JavaScript console messages (log, info, warn, error).

properties.name: jsDialogListener
properties.description: Listener to handle or suppress JavaScript alert, confirm, and prompt dialogs.

properties.name: popupListener
properties.description: Listener for popup window requests (window.open).

properties.name: authListener
properties.description: Listener for HTTP Basic/Digest and proxy authentication challenges.

properties.name: contextMenuListener
properties.description: Listener for right-click context menu construction and customization.

properties.name: permissionListener
properties.description: Listener for camera, microphone, screen share, and media device permission requests.

properties.name: loadErrorListener
properties.description: Listener for frame load failures, DNS resolution errors, and connection dropouts.

properties.name: isOffScreenRendered
properties.description: Whether browsers in this client use off-screen rendering (OSR) into pixel buffers.

properties.name: isTransparent
properties.description: Whether the web view canvas background is transparent.

properties.name: framework
properties.description: Target UI framework (COMPOSE, SWING, JAVAFX, SWT, AWT) for OSR canvas factory resolution.

properties.name: sslErrorPolicy
properties.description: SSL certificate verification policy (Strict, IgnoreAll, AllowHostList, Custom).

properties.name: initialWidth
properties.description: Initial viewport width in pixels.

properties.name: initialHeight
properties.description: Initial viewport height in pixels.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Returns the default client configuration instance.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for KromiumClientConfig.
